issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling or edge cases for unsupported formats or ffmpeg failures.
The code uses bash syntax that may not work on Windows without a Unix-like shell, indicating minor platform assumptions.

scenarios.name: convert-mkv-to-mp4-stream-copy
scenarios.rationale: Both responses include an ffmpeg command with -i, -c copy, -movflags +faststart, and outputting the same base name with a .mp4 extension.

scenarios.name: extract-and-normalize-audio
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes a single ffmpeg command that satisfies all rubric items, while Response B splits the process into separate steps and never uses the loudnorm filter on the video input in one command.

scenarios.name: create-gif-with-palette
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets all rubric items exactly, while Response B omits the required 480 width scale, though it otherwise satisfies the rest.
